title: Palimpsestus Conformance Surface: Machine-Checkable Reference Verification Suite
description: Reference conformance verification suite for the Palimpsestus Specification. Implements machine-checkable structural DAG invariant validation (8 invariants), constitutional migration proofs (C0 -> C1), Zero-Theater intent receipt & crash recovery test harnesses, live 3,269-entry Markdown corpus verification, and deterministic classifier consistency benchmarks.
